comment: Tier 4 (ungoverned) sidecar for css-pass, this repo's own local roster.json equivalent, per the css-pass skill's own row shape (roster.json fields, minus pattern-book-specific ones: generated/generator/extracted/icon_family don't apply to a single-page repo with no pattern-book presence of its own). This repo is NOT one of the pattern-book-governed repos (Jonathanlindavis.com, Microgroup.info) and has no roster.json row of its own; style_invariants.py's mechanical floor does not run against it. Its roster.json SIBLING mirror page, open-data-f4f.html on Jonathanlindavis.com (group 'public-data', convention ['general']), is the register precedent this page's own audience declaration below matches.
